description: A row of all-pass filters that delays some frequencies more than others, smearing a transient into a downward chirp without changing its level

params.text: Sets the frequency the smearing is centred on, 20Hz at the far left and 20kHz at the far right
Sets how much of the freq jack's voltage reaches the frequency, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre
Sets how many all-pass stages the signal passes through, none at the far left and 32 at the far right; more stages means a longer smear
Sets how much of the amount jack's voltage reaches the stage count, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre
Sets the sharpness of the all-pass peak, a wide smear at the far left and a tight one at the far right
Sets how much of the pinch jack's voltage reaches the sharpness, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre

inputs.text: Shifts the centre frequency, scaled by the trim beneath the freq knob
Shifts the stage count, scaled by its own trim
Shifts the peak sharpness, scaled by its own trim

notes: each of the three CV jacks does nothing until its trim is moved away from the centre, which is where all three start
menu: Freq CV Filter — smooths the voltage arriving at the freq jack, which keeps a stepped or noisy CV from making the smear jump
